posted_text:
🏢 MI HB 6427 — Data Centers Get a Zoning Shield in Michigan

Michigan is creating a new layer of protection for data centers. This bill adds the ‘Data Center Local Decision Protection Act’ to zoning regulations, meaning county and township rules can’t block the construction of new data centers. It also clarifies that local governments can’t regulate oil and gas drilling or mining operations unless there are ‘very serious consequences’ from doing so, and sets a high bar for challenging zoning decisions… ...
